purpose: Hand-curated positive and negative phrasing examples for human/editorial checks; not a universal natural-language classifier.
independence: All examples are author-crafted. They are not externally adjudicated.

examples.claim: The declared synthetic compressor mass and first-law residuals are within their thresholds.
examples.available_evidence: The two specified residuals on the supplied synthetic input.
examples.limitation: Not a verified operating point or experimentally validated compressor.

examples.available_evidence: No empirical benchmark or general model validation has been performed.
examples.limitation: Conservation residuals alone are insufficient for real-world validation.

examples.claim: A wrong target operating point may still pass when mass flows and shaft work change together.
examples.available_evidence: A documented synthetic compensated perturbation passes both declared checks.
examples.limitation: The target operating point is not inferred from conservation.

examples.claim: PASS_IN_SCOPE proves this compressor is operating at the correct point.
examples.available_evidence: No independently specified operating-point reference is evaluated.
examples.limitation: The documented compensated perturbation also passes.

examples.claim: The single interval energy-accounting residual is within the stated threshold.
examples.available_evidence: The declared storage interval energy balance was evaluated.
examples.limitation: This does not test deliverable temperature or time-series chronology.

examples.claim: The storage capacity has been verified.
examples.available_evidence: Capacity_j was omitted; storage_capacity is NOT_CHECKED.

examples.claim: Storage capacity was not checked because capacity_j was absent.
examples.available_evidence: The explicit NOT_CHECKED entry has null numeric fields.
examples.limitation: This is not an evaluated pass or fail.

examples.claim: The submitted input declares its evidence class as experimental; that declaration was not authenticated.
examples.limitation: No independent measurement or provenance verification occurred.

examples.claim: An experimental provenance label establishes independent validation.
examples.available_evidence: The label is declared by the data provider and need not be true.
examples.limitation: No independent observations, reference quality or UQ were examined.

examples.claim: The listed CI run passed the defined software tests on the reported platforms.
examples.available_evidence: The GitHub Actions job logs show software checks completed.
examples.limitation: CI alone does not establish real-world engineering accuracy.

examples.claim: EnerLint is ASME certified and scientifically validated by CI.
examples.available_evidence: No qualification/certification process or real-model validation has taken place.
examples.limitation: An ASME reference is not institutional approval.

examples.claim: A SHA-256 input fingerprint independently authenticates model measurements.
examples.available_evidence: Hashing detects changes to the submitted canonical JSON object.
examples.limitation: The source and measurements might still be fabricated.

examples.claim: A native-versus-EnerLint comparison has been specified but not executed.
examples.available_evidence: The D1 protocol defines planned conditions and reporting fields.
examples.limitation: No comparative performance can be concluded.

examples.claim: EnerLint detects more errors than native TESPy diagnostics.
examples.available_evidence: The comparative experiment has not been conducted.
examples.limitation: No fair native-diagnostics outcome ledger exists.

examples.claim: This input was rejected; no physical checks were run.
examples.available_evidence: INVALID_INPUT produces no evaluated check entries.
examples.limitation: It does not establish a physical fault in the upstream model.

examples.claim: The upstream physical model is incorrect because EnerLint rejected its input.
examples.available_evidence: A malformed input may be a serialization or contract error.

examples.claim: The author supplied all mandatory boundary-review declarations; their physical truth remains unverified.
examples.available_evidence: Optional sidecar fields and input fingerprint were checked.
examples.limitation: Real unreported pipes and energy transfers may still exist.

examples.claim: The author-attested checklist independently certifies the physical control volume.
examples.available_evidence: A maintainer's answers are only an attestation.
examples.limitation: No independent physical boundary audit was performed.
